skip_reasons: Two Metal-only writer tests unavailable on CPU

native_apple_silicon.scope: Actual tiny native Qwen models and Model wrappers, no pretrained model loaded for tests.

coverage: Distinct earlier emitted prefixes affect readout despite equal most-recent token
Changing evolving reverse vectors affects subsequent causal state
Every pending reverse projection and recurrence object survives causal calls unchanged
Reverse context advancement is bit-identical with and without causal calls in current/delta modes
Causal backbone uses current matrices without altering delta reverse semantics
Separate output-head index resolves the actual untied Qwen Model wrapper
Vocabulary head is never invoked during emission
Missing untied output head fails explicitly, not a silent input-table fallback
Output caches reset between runs; debug does not change output
Existing attention window bounds generated cache memory but does not cap emissions
Capture suppressed and restored: generated output never enters source observation buffers
Classes and capture restored after exceptions

additional_checks: Forty output steps with a four-position attention window reached a constant active MLX memory plateau

compatibility: Independent readout remains default; sequence feedback is explicit. Checkpoint schema and original reverse movement termination unchanged.
limitations: Soft conditioning is an untrained equal blend of reverse direction and prior emitted embedding.
Coordinate partition of output-head rows is approximate token selection, not native LM probabilities or a trained hierarchical head.
Mechanical tests establish sequence dependence, not semantic grounding or coherence.
Source snapshot is unchanged; only generated-output causal state is transiently retained.
Deployment and the single requested orchard run are tracked separately.
